title: ruellia costata
intro: Ruellia costata, commonly known as the Mexican petunia, is a perennial flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Ruellia costata include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to relax the muscles, ease coughs, and reduce swelling. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
